p05.title: Actions to agents
p05.events: GitHub Actions reacts to events and runs operations.
p05.steps: When X happens, run Y, then Z. It works.
p05.intent: Not a list of steps. An intent the agent reasons about.
p05.prompt: One Markdown file. The body is the prompt.
p05.compiler: The compiler builds a secure frame around the agent.
p05.ours: Then a small script of ours adapts the YAML.
p05.system: CI/CD, agents, issues, pull requests. All in the cloud.
p05.story: We could stop here. This is where the real story starts.
p05.evt.label: label added
p06.title: The problems
p06.runs: The same prompt does not give the same result.
p06.runs.source: The same task can vary 30-fold in tokens. Bai et al., 2026
p06.cost: An agent can do this. That does not mean it must.
p06.cost.source: One issue: 17 minutes and 2.4M tokens, twice, with no result.
p06.human: Human attention is the thing that runs out.
p06.human.source: Top reason agent pull requests fail: nobody reviewed them (38%). Ehsani et al., MSR 2026
p07.title: A change of mind
p07.before: We ran tests to prove that humans had to stay.
p07.question: What would have to be true for this to work without humans on the normal path?
p07.client: A very small team, many products. So we became our own client.
p07.line.1: It must reason, not only automate.
p07.line.3: Start a job and forget it. Nobody watches.
p07.line.4: No one's laptop. A fresh checkout on every run.
p07.case.title: Plain Concepts Platform
p08.title: Our runtime
p08.adapt: We keep the security. We change how we get it.
p08.adapt.source: Threat detection is off: our scanners already check every pull request.
p08.opencode: Every agentic job runs OpenCode. One place to control the agent.
p08.forge: The spend and the model choice stay ours.
p08.forge.source: Foundations. One Forge key per project.
p09.pillars: Four things we had to build.
p09.title: Agent Harness
p09.improvise: Every repo improvises. A different answer every run.
p09.frame: How an agent works in this repo. It does not start from zero.
p09.clean: We cannot make an agent deterministic. We can make each run look like the last one.
p09.clean.source: Instruction files took agent success from 38% to 69%. .NET Blog, 2026
p09.blocked: About twelve unsafe actions are blocked at the tool call.
p09.laptop: The same Harness on a laptop and in the cloud.
p10.title: Agentic Workflows
p10.caption.pieces: Every piece that leaves the agent now does the same thing, every time.
p10.caption.distance: The closer to the model, the less a path repeats.
p10.back: We came back to GitHub Actions. The system is hybrid.
p10.resort: The model is the last resort, not the engine.
p10.before: Before: every workflow woke up on every event.
p10.router: One router. One event, one decision, at most one agent.
p10.router.source: An event that needs nothing costs about ten seconds.
p10.lanes: The person who asks decides what gets built. No human reads the code.
p10.gate: The merge gate decides on evidence: merge, ask a human, or block.
p10.gate.source: Our first gate auto-merged 31% and found zero defects.
p10.side: Housekeeping retries stalled work. Audit files what it finds.
p11.title: Foundations
p11.amplify: AI amplifies what a team already has, good and bad.
p11.amplify.source: DORA 2025. In 2024: 25% more AI adoption, 7.2% less delivery stability.
p11.phases: The phases are not a schedule. What changes is who may start a change.
p11.phases.source: Outcomes belong to the business. Means belong to engineering.
p11.phase.1: discovery: we decide what to build
p11.disc: One obvious way to do each thing.
p11.disc.source: A convention costs a paragraph. Shared code costs a version, a migration path, and a maintainer. Foundations
p11.walls: A guardrail fails the build. A document does not.
p11.walls.source: An agent told to make the build pass will make the build pass. Foundations
p11.verbs: An agent is not given a trust level. It is given a set of verbs.
p11.skip.source: If the answer is 'probably fine', the guardrails are not finished. Foundations
p12.title: Project Health
p12.claim: Autonomy you cannot measure is only a claim.
p12.measure: No database, no service. JSON files and a static site, every day.
p12.honest: A missing metric is a fact about the data, not a gap to fill.
p12.honest.source: We once counted 140 agent runs that never ran an agent. We fixed the collector.
p12.human: Once agents implement, count what still needs a person.
p12.numbers.head: Our numbers, next to the industry
p12.pair.1.name: Autonomy
p12.pair.1.oursText: of our merged agent PRs, merged by the bot
p12.pair.1.publicText: of agent PRs merge on GitHub, all by a human
p12.pair.2.name: Reliability
p12.pair.2.oursText: of our agent runs succeed end to end
p12.pair.2.publicText: of Copilot agent PRs merged in dotnet/runtime
p12.pair.3.name: Speed
p12.pair.3.publicText: of teams need over a week of lead time
p12.numbers.foot: Public figures come from pull requests a human reviewed. Our window: seven weeks. Li 2025, Ehsani 2026, .NET Blog 2026, DORA 2025
p12.loop: The system's own defects are worked like the product's.
p13.title: Issue to production
p13.real: A real issue from one of our apps.
p13.step.1: Someone in the business files a request. They never opened the repo.
p13.step.2: Triage checks it. Refine turns it into a story and asks one question.
p13.step.3: The person who asked decides what gets built. The story starts on its own.
p13.step.4: Implement opens OpenCode with the Harness, writes the code, and opens one pull request.
p13.step.5: CI runs the linting, the tests, the scanners, and the guardrails.
p13.step.6: The merge gate reads the risk and the evidence, and merges.
p13.step.7: It reaches production, and Project Health counts it.
p13.pair.1: Someone in the business asks, without opening the repo. Triage checks it and refine writes the story.
p13.pair.2: The person who asked decides what gets built. Implement starts on its own and opens a pull request with the Harness.
p13.pair.3: CI runs the tests, the scanners and the guardrails. The merge gate reads the risk and the evidence, and merges.
p14.slots: Autonomy did not come from a better model. It came from the system around it.
p14.timeline: The model can change. The system around it stays.
p14.entry: Agentic Workflows is the entry point, not the whole solution.
p14.last: More autonomy does not need less structure. It needs better structure.
